title: The Riemann hypothesis is equivalent to an asymptotic for the average number of Goldbach representations, after Granville 2007
abstract: A sorry-free Lean 4 proof of Theorem 1A of A. Granville, Refinements of Goldbach's conjecture, and the generalized Riemann hypothesis, Funct. Approx. Comment. Math. 37 (2007): with G(n) the sum over m1 + m2 = n of Lambda(m1) Lambda(m2), Mathlib's RiemannHypothesis holds if and only if the sum of G(n) over n <= N is N^2/2 + O(N^{3/2+eps}) for every eps > 0. Both directions are proved with no hypothesis: RH implies the asymptotic through the von Koch bound for psi(x) - x, and the asymptotic implies RH by the route reconstructed in part by Bhowmik, Halupczok, Matsumoto, Suzuki (arXiv 1704.06103) and completed by Bhowmik and Ruzsa (arXiv 1711.06442). Binary Goldbach is not claimed. Lean code written by an AI agent; the statements were checked against the literature by an AI reviewer and are offered for human audit.
